inputs.original_text: In Hyderabad, BRS Working President KT Rama Rao (KTR) accused the Congress government on Sunday, March 29, of corruption and failing to act against illegal mining. He alleged that Raghava Constructions, a company belonging to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy, is involved in illegal mining. The account says the Sircilla MLA questioned something, but the sentence cuts off before saying what.
inputs.modified_text: KTR’s accusation points to a protection racket dressed up as government inaction: he says the Congress government is failing to act on illegal mining while Raghava Constructions, which he alleges belongs to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy, is involved. The account abruptly cuts off just as the Sircilla MLA was questioning something—conveniently leaving out what he was challenging. When the allegation reaches a minister’s company, silence and missing details deserve suspicion, not blind trust.
